experiment.title: Text-to-3D adapter routing (adapter=auto) vs always-on adapter and base

config.description: Adapter routing (service default adapter=auto): the capsule LoRA adapter is applied only to prompts that name its concept. Same protocol berkelium-text3d-eval/1, dataset, resolution and splits as E-T1, released checkpoints from exports/. Routed vs always-on adapter and vs base, on held-out base families (test, retention) and held-out capsule families (adapter_test).
